data.one_liner: Manage a finite pool of resources to control concurrent operations.
data.what_it_does: The pool package exposes a Pool class that makes it easy to manage a limited pool of resources. It controls concurrent file system or network requests through withResource or fine-grained PoolResource management.
use_when: You need to limit concurrent file system or network requests.
You want to process an iterable asynchronously with a maximum concurrency limit.
avoid_when: You are managing state or UI components.
You do not need to limit concurrency.
strengths: Easy to use with withResource callbacks.
Supports fine-grained control via PoolResource objects.
weaknesses: Requires manual tracking to ensure physical resources correspond correctly to pool allocations.
